description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
